title: Broker Roundup | October
summary: This month, we're highlighting new ways for brokers to simplify financing workflows, automate everyday tasks, and close more deals. From our dedicated Commercial Real Estate financing experience to new AI-powered capabilities that make managing applications easier than ever, Lendflow is helping brokers spend less time on manual work and more time serving their clients. Explore our latest updates and discover how you can streamline your deal flow, improve the borrower experience, and grow your business. Interested in learning more? Reach out to the Lendflow team to see how these solutions can support your brokerage.
body_markdown:
#### **Lendflow News**


#### [Now Available: Lendflow's Commercial Real Estate Financing Workflow](https://www.lendflow.com/post/lendflow-commercial-real-estate-financing-workflow)


Lendflow now provides a dedicated commercial real estate financing experience designed to simplify how borrowers apply for property-backed loans. Through a guided application, borrowers can provide property details, financial information, and supporting documents before their request is routed to lending partners for review. See how it works and talk to our team to create a custom experience for your customers.


[Read More >](https://www.lendflow.com/post/lendflow-commercial-real-estate-financing-workflow)


‍


#### **Lender Highlight**


#### [How to Use Lendflow in ChatGPT: A Guide to the Lendflow Plugin](https://www.lendflow.com/post/bizbe-partners-with-lendflow-to-launch-bizbe-capital)


The Lendflow plugin connects ChatGPT with your Lendflow environment so lending teams can find application data, review offers, create applications, add notes, upload documents, and complete lending tasks conversationally.


[Learn More >](https://www.lendflow.com/post/lendflow-chatgpt-plugin)


‍


#### Lendflow News


#### [Less Chasing, More Closing: How Brokers Can Put AI to Work](https://www.lendflow.com/post/less-chasing-more-closing-how-brokers-can-put-ai-to-work)


AI can help brokers deliver a more responsive experience, prepare stronger submissions, and manage more opportunities with their existing team. Lendflow brings these capabilities together through AI agents, connected lending infrastructure, plugins and MCP connectors, and workflows tailored for Commercial Real Estate, Equipment, and Business Acquisition Brokers.


[Read the Article >](https://www.lendflow.com/post/less-chasing-more-closing-how-brokers-can-put-ai-to-work)
